title: System4D Intake Interview
description: First-pass discovery interview before explorer subagents run.

questions.question: Boundary (in-scope): What does this workflow own?
Boundary (out-of-scope): What must be excluded?
Hard constraints (select all)
Edge/integration points: Which systems/teams/interfaces are touched?
Dependencies: Which external approvals/releases/resources are required?
Anti-goals: What should we explicitly not optimize for now?
Primary driver (why now?)
Outcome: What measurable value should this deliver?
Trade-offs to prioritize (top 2-3)
Trigger: What event/action starts this workflow?
States: Which states and transitions matter?
Invariants: What must always remain true?
Lifecycle: How should create/change/archive/retire be handled?
Assumptions: What are we assuming without proof?
Top risks and early warning signals?
Exceptions/error paths: Which non-happy paths are likely?
Debt tolerance: What shortcuts are acceptable, and when must they be paid back?
Success criteria: How will we know this iteration is done?
DB explorer path confirmation (read-only): which DB file should Stage-1 DB explorer inspect?
questions.context: This is DB input for exploration only, not where interview answers are stored.

questions.question: Optional: Upload architecture sketches or reference artifacts
